cpmwheel.eff.effect.help: Click to pick from every effect in the game, modded ones too.
cpmwheel.eff.end.help: Restore: each animation goes back to exactly its previous value (also on death or milk). If you change something by hand during the effect, your choice stays.

cpmwheel.phys.react.help: How much jumping, falling, landing, starting and stopping swing the item (0 = like the old lantern).

cpmwheel.phys.kick.help: Gives it a push to see the effect (hold the item).

cpmwheel.l2d.guide.title: Setting up in the CPM editor
cpmwheel.l2d.guide.text:
What it does: CPM Wheel runs a spring simulation per link and writes it to a Value Layer of your model 20 times per second.

1. Bones in CPM
- Make an empty bone "hair_center" as a child of the head, pivot at the hair root.
- Make "hair_tips" as a CHILD of "hair_center", pivot where the strand bends.

2. Center animation
- Add an animation with these settings:
  * Value Layer, Max value 255, Interpolate Value on;
  * Command Activated + Hidden;
  * Linear Single, 1000 ms.
- Frame 1 (value 0) = Z -45, Frame 2 (value 255) = Z +45. The middle is rest.

3. Tips
- Same with another layer moving only "hair_tips".

4. In game
- Press "+ Hair". Link 1 already has head yaw 100%, body yaw 50% inverted and forward/back walk 20% inverted.
- Link 2 uses the previous link.
- Pick the layers and turn it on.

Several inputs
- Each link has a list of inputs (source, weight %, +/−); the weighted sum drives it.
- "Walk forward/back" is + forward and − backward (relative to the body).
- "Walk sideways" is + right and − left.
- "Walk speed" has no direction.

Shared layers
- Links using the same layer are combined (Sum by default, or Average / Largest) and written once per tick, clamped to 0..max.

Disable when (e.g. wings)
- Each chain has "Disable when…": conditions that suspend the physics.
  * any CPM / wheel animation playing ("Animation" type, hidden/command ones included);
  * Flying, Gliding (elytra), Swimming, Riding, Sleeping, Sneaking;
  * or any trigger condition.
- While true, the value fades back to rest over the fade time (default 0.3 s), then the mod stops writing the layer.
- It fades back in when the condition ends.
- Wings example: add "Animation" = "fly" and "Gliding" to the wing chain.
- The ⏸ button of a link does the same for one link.

Impulse ↔ Held (1.7.3)
- Under each input there is an "Impulse ↔ Held" slider (only for "lag" output).
- 0% = impulse only: the link swings when the input CHANGES and then settles back to rest even while the input continues (the only behaviour up to 1.7.2).
- 100% = held: while the input lasts the link stays displaced (like Live2D), still swinging when it starts and stops.
- Defaults: speeds 75%, head/body yaw 0%.
- Speeds are smoothed (~0.15 s) and measured from the real movement, so jumps and ground/air changes don't flicker.

New in 1.8.0
- Preview: live graphs, an animated chain and simulated inputs.
- Extras (all off until enabled): wind, impacts, look-at, voice (Simple Voice Chat), animation motion, breathing/blinking.
- New inputs: falling, gravity/look, wind, damage/landing impacts, look-at, voice, layer/animation motion. Shift+click the source to go back.
- Soft limit (link ⚙), Mirror chain, Presets (file or clipboard text).
cpmwheel.l2d.status.off: Off (turn it on at the left)
cpmwheel.l2d.failed: Stopped after an error (see the log)
cpmwheel.l2d.empty: No chains yet. Use "+ Hair" or "+ Tail" below and read "How to set up". Tip: in CPM use Value Layer, Max value 255, Interpolate Value on, Command Activated + Hidden, Linear Single, 1000 ms.
cpmwheel.l2d.add.hair.help: New 2-link chain. Center: head yaw 100% + body yaw 50% inverted + forward/back 20% inverted. Tips: previous link.
cpmwheel.l2d.add.tail.help: New 2-link chain. Base: body yaw + sideways 30% inverted. Tip: previous link. Heavier and slower.
cpmwheel.l2d.link.add.help: Adds a link at the end; it follows the previous one (tips lag behind the center).
cpmwheel.l2d.anim.help: The CPM Value Layer this link moves. Command/hidden animations are listed too.
cpmwheel.l2d.input.help: Click to change the source. The link follows the weighted sum of all inputs (weight %, + normal / − inverted).
cpmwheel.l2d.in.bodyYaw.help: The body turning (follows the head). Good for tails and skirts.
cpmwheel.l2d.in.walk.help: Ground speed without direction (10° per block/s). Use "Walk forward/back" to tell forward from backward.
cpmwheel.l2d.in.prev.help: Follows the link above in the list: tips lag behind the center.
cpmwheel.l2d.out.help:
Lag: how far the link trails what moves it (for bones parented to the head / center). With "Impulse ↔ Held" above 0% the input keeps the link displaced while it lasts.
Follow: the link's whole angle (always held).
cpmwheel.l2d.gain.help: Strength: multiplies the sum of all inputs.
cpmwheel.l2d.max.help: Angle that becomes the max value (last frame). The middle is rest.
cpmwheel.l2d.live.none: Now: (turn the physics on to see)
cpmwheel.l2d.pick.typed.help: Uses the typed name even if the current model doesn't have that layer.
cpmwheel.l2d.pick.none: This model has no value layers (Value Layer with max value above 1). See "How to set up".
cpmwheel.l2d.in.headRel.help: How far the head is turned relative to the body (−180..180°).
cpmwheel.l2d.in.fwd.help: Signed speed relative to the body: + forward, − backward (10° per block/s).
cpmwheel.l2d.in.side.help: Signed sideways speed relative to the body: + right, − left (10° per block/s).
cpmwheel.l2d.in.add.help: Adds another input to this link (up to 4).
cpmwheel.l2d.mode.help: How links on this layer combine: Sum of offsets from rest, Average, or the Largest offset. Clamped to 0..max.
cpmwheel.cond.t.anim.short: A model or wheel animation is playing.
cpmwheel.cond.t.anim.help: True while the chosen animation (CPM or wheel, gestures, layers and hidden ones included) plays with value ≥ the minimum.
cpmwheel.cond.anim.min.help: Minimum value to count as playing (1 = on; use more for value layers).
cpmwheel.cond.t.fly.help: True while flying in creative or with a flight ability.
cpmwheel.cond.t.glide.help: True while gliding with an elytra.
cpmwheel.cond.combine.or.susp: Suspends when ANY condition is true (OR)
cpmwheel.cond.combine.and.susp: Suspends when ALL conditions are true (AND)
cpmwheel.cond.combine.susp.help: Click to switch between ANY (OR) and ALL (AND). Usually OR: e.g. "fly" OR "Gliding".
cpmwheel.cond.empty.susp: No conditions: the physics is never suspended.
cpmwheel.l2d.fade.help: Time to fade to rest when suspended (and back when resumed). Default 0.3 s.
cpmwheel.l2d.off.title: Disable physics when
cpmwheel.l2d.off.help: Conditions that suspend this chain: an animation playing (e.g. "fly"), flying, gliding, swimming, riding, sleeping, sneaking… It fades to rest and stops writing, so the other animation takes over.
cpmwheel.l2d.off.link.title: Disable this link when
cpmwheel.l2d.off.link.help: ⏸ Disable when, for this link only (on top of the chain's list). Uses the chain's fade.
cpmwheel.l2d.hold.help:
0% = impulse: the link swings when this input changes, then settles back to rest.
100% = held: while the input lasts (e.g. walking) the link stays displaced, swinging when it starts and stops.
Default: speeds 75%, yaw 0%.
cpmwheel.set.link.ek: Pick the emotes of the keys…
cpmwheel.l2d.in.fall.help: Only falling speed (0 going up), 10° per block/s.
cpmwheel.l2d.in.grav.help: Opposite of the head pitch (+ looking up), held 100%: hair keeps hanging down.
cpmwheel.l2d.in.windF.help: Headwind (+) or tailwind (−) with gusts; stronger in rain, storms, high up. Enable in Extras.
cpmwheel.l2d.in.windS.help: Wind from the right (+) or left (−), with gusts. Enable in Extras.
cpmwheel.l2d.in.hit.help: A kick when you take damage, scaled by the damage. Enable in Extras.
cpmwheel.l2d.in.land.help: A kick when you land, scaled by the fall speed. Enable in Extras.
cpmwheel.l2d.in.lookYaw.help: Angle to the nearest player/mob (+ right, up to ±60°). Enable in Extras.
cpmwheel.l2d.in.lookPitch.help: Vertical angle to the target (+ below). Enable in Extras.
cpmwheel.l2d.in.voice.help: Mouth 0..45° while you talk in Simple Voice Chat (if installed). Use "Follow" output. Enable in Extras.
cpmwheel.l2d.in.layer.help: Reads a CPM animation or layer: its rate of change, its value, or an oscillating push while it plays. Enable in Extras.
cpmwheel.l2d.ref.help: CPM animation or layer that drives this input.
cpmwheel.l2d.ref.mode.help: Rate = how fast the value changes. Value = current value (0..45°). Oscillate = while it plays, a ±45° push at the chosen frequency.
cpmwheel.l2d.btn.prev.help: Live graphs, an animated chain and simulated inputs to tune standing still.
cpmwheel.l2d.btn.ext.help: Wind, impacts, look-at, voice, animation motion, breathing and blinking. All off by default.
cpmwheel.l2d.btn.io.help: Export / import chains as a file (config/cpmwheel/l2d) or clipboard text.
cpmwheel.l2d.mirror.help: Copies this chain with left/right swapped (yaw and sideways inputs inverted), then pick the layers.
cpmwheel.l2d.mirror.title: Mirror chain: layers
cpmwheel.l2d.mirror.info: "%s" created. Layers with left/right in the name were swapped; pick the missing ones.
cpmwheel.l2d.more.help: More link options: soft angle limit.
cpmwheel.l2d.more.title: Link: more options
cpmwheel.l2d.lim.help: The output angle approaches the limits smoothly and never passes them.
cpmwheel.l2d.lim.text: Unlike Min/Max (which only map the angle to a value), the soft limit slows the motion near the edges.
cpmwheel.l2d.prev.title: Live2D physics: live preview
cpmwheel.l2d.prev.off: Live2D physics is off: turn it on to see the model move.
cpmwheel.l2d.prev.legend: cyan = angle  ·  yellow = value  ·  last 5 s
cpmwheel.l2d.sim.help: Added to the real input only while this screen is open.
cpmwheel.l2d.ext.title: Live2D physics: extras
cpmwheel.l2d.ext.wind.help: Enables the wind inputs: gusts, rain ×1.8, thunder ×3, stronger high up and in open biomes, weak under a roof.
cpmwheel.l2d.ext.impact.help: Enables the damage and landing kicks.
cpmwheel.l2d.ext.look.help: Turns on the "Look" inputs. By default the target is whoever is in the area around the centre of YOUR view (the crosshair), never the camera; open "Look: options…" for targets, area, privacy filters and smoothing.
cpmwheel.l2d.ext.voice.help: Enables the Voice input with Simple Voice Chat (optional). It doesn't report your own microphone loudness, so the mouth flaps while you talk.
cpmwheel.l2d.ext.layer.help: Enables the Layer/animation input: other animations push the physics.
cpmwheel.l2d.gen.help: Automatic generators driving value layers: breathing (smooth wave) and blinking (pulse at random intervals).
cpmwheel.l2d.gen.breath.help: Smooth wave between min and max. Period = one cycle.
cpmwheel.l2d.gen.blink.help: Closes (max) and opens (min) quickly at random intervals.
cpmwheel.l2d.gen.anim.help: Value layer driven by this generator.
cpmwheel.l2d.gen.range.help: Range in % of the layer's max value (min = rest).
cpmwheel.l2d.gen.rand.help: Random change of timing and strength.
cpmwheel.l2d.io.title: Live2D physics: export / import
cpmwheel.l2d.io.name: file name
cpmwheel.l2d.io.save.help: Saves to config/cpmwheel/l2d/<name>.json. "All" includes every chain and the generators.
cpmwheel.l2d.io.paste.help: Imports clipboard text. Chains are ADDED.
cpmwheel.ek.title: Emote keys
cpmwheel.ek.help: Up to 8 keys that play a chosen emote without the wheel. Bind them in Options › Controls › CPM Wheel.
cpmwheel.ek.pick.help: Pick the animation of this key.
cpmwheel.ct.title: Chained animations
cpmwheel.ct.help: When an animation ends (or starts), play, stop or toggle another after a delay.
cpmwheel.ct.when.help: End = when A stops. Start = when A turns on.
cpmwheel.ct.op.help: ON plays B, OFF stops it, TOGGLE switches.
cpmwheel.ct.test.help: Runs the action on B now.
cpmwheel.prof.title: Automatic profiles per model
cpmwheel.prof.help: Each CPM model already has its own config. With this on, models linked to a named PROFILE use it (wheel, triggers, physics, hands), switching automatically when you change model.
cpmwheel.prof.name: profile name
cpmwheel.prof.link.help: Links the current model to this profile (a new profile starts from this model's settings).
cpmwheel.ec.on.help: Turns on the bridge to the optional Emotecraft mod: "Emotecraft emote" wheel button, "Emotecraft emote playing" condition (rules, chained animations and physics "Disable when") and physics behaviour during emotes. Hidden without Emotecraft.
cpmwheel.ec.l2d.help: While an Emotecraft emote plays on you: nothing; off = every Live2D chain lets go (with its fade); kick = a kick at the start and end on the "Emotecraft emote (kick)" input.
cpmwheel.ec.kick.help: Size of the kick at the start and end of each emote.
cpmwheel.ec.offmsg: CPM Wheel: turn the Emotecraft integration on in Settings › Compatibility › Emotecraft.
cpmwheel.ec.pick.title: Pick an Emotecraft emote
cpmwheel.ec.action.help: play/stop: plays, or stops it if it is playing. play: always (re)starts. stop any emote: stops the playing emote.
cpmwheel.ec.emote.help: Emotecraft emote played by this button.
cpmwheel.cond.t.emote.short: An Emotecraft emote is playing on you (any or a named one).
cpmwheel.cond.t.emote.help: True while an Emotecraft emote plays on your character. Needs Emotecraft and the integration on.
cpmwheel.l2d.in.emote.help: A kick when an Emotecraft emote starts or ends ("kick" mode in the Emotecraft settings).
cpmwheel.ec.icon.help: Shows the Emotecraft emote icon on the wheel button and in the HUD (a generic icon when the emote has none). Follows the icon size and icon-only settings. An icon set in the Icon field wins.
cpmwheel.ec.info.hint: Click an emote to see its icon and details. Double click or "Choose" to use it.
cpmwheel.ec.info.author: Author: %s
cpmwheel.look.open.help: Targets (players/mobs), screen area, privacy filters (free camera, invisible, vanish, line of sight) and eye smoothing.
cpmwheel.look.title: Live2D physics: look
cpmwheel.look.targets.help: Who can be looked at. "None" keeps the eyes following your head only.
cpmwheel.look.mode.help: Screen area (default): looks at whoever is inside the area around the centre of your view and closest to it; distance only breaks ties. Nearest: the old way, closest within the cone.
cpmwheel.look.fov.help: Nearest mode: only targets inside this angle around your head direction count.
cpmwheel.look.sticky.help: Stops flicking between two targets: the current one stays until it leaves the area grown by this %, and another only wins if it is better by the same %.
cpmwheel.look.switch.help: Right after a target change the eyes move with at least this response time (0 = normal).
cpmwheel.look.maxyaw.help: Side angle limit sent to the layers (up/down stays at ±45°).
cpmwheel.look.area.help: Area size in % of the screen (circle: radius in % of the height). The preview draws the outline over the game.
cpmwheel.look.off.help: Moves the centre of the area (in % of the screen).
cpmwheel.look.preview.help: Shows the area outline and the current target while this screen is open.
cpmwheel.look.debug.help: Draws the area, the target and how many were skipped (and why) on the HUD while playing. Only you see it.
cpmwheel.look.safecam.help: Never uses the camera or camera entities (Freecam, Flashback/ReplayMod, F5, spectating) as a target. The direction always comes from your character.
cpmwheel.look.hidden.help: Skips invisible entities, spectators, players missing from the Tab list or unknown to the server, and entities the game wouldn't draw.
cpmwheel.look.vanish.help: Skips players with vanish marks on their Tab name or team (e.g. "[V]", "Vanished"). Best effort: not every plugin marks them.
cpmwheel.look.los.help: Only looks at entities you can see, with no blocks between your eyes and them.
cpmwheel.look.smooth.help: How the eyes reach the target. Spring = critically damped, arrives in about the response time without wobbling.
cpmwheel.look.resp.help: About how long the eyes take to reach the target.
cpmwheel.look.maxspeed.help: Eye speed limit in degrees per second (0 = no limit).
cpmwheel.look.saccade.help: Small random gaze shifts (up to 4° at 100 %), like real eyes.
cpmwheel.look.return.help: When the target is gone the eyes stay on the last spot for this long, then go back to the centre.
cpmwheel.blink.title: Live2D physics: blink
cpmwheel.blink.times.help: Time to close, stay closed and open. CPM layers change 20 times per second, so times under 50 ms become a single step.
cpmwheel.blink.curve.help: Easing when closing and opening (smooth = slow start and end).
cpmwheel.blink.double.help: Chance of blinking again right after (never three).
cpmwheel.blink.more.help: Other layers moved together with this generator (e.g. the other eyelid), up to 4.
cpmwheel.blink.short: Short: under ~150 ms the smoothing barely shows.
